en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a busy cobblestoned street intersection in an early-20th‑century European city. Multi‑story neoclassical buildings with balconies line both sides of the street, a tram is visible on the left, and many pedestrians, soldiers, and townspeople stand or walk in the square. The image is framed with printed captions in French and English along the bottom, identifying the scene as Venizelos Street in Salonica during the First World War.
